thread:
Alyssa (AE): quick heads-up — LumenAxis CISO flagged the BYO-KMS clause in the security questionnaire. They say we must provide key residency attestation + HSM proof before POC. POC is on hold until we confirm.
Mike (Solutions Eng): copy. can you paste the exact clause or screenshot? want to confirm scope (encryption at rest vs. key control).
Alyssa (AE): here's the excerpt they sent: 

> "Customer-managed KMS: all encryption keys used for processing customer data must remain under Customer control in an HSM certified to FIPS 140-2 within the customer's EU jurisdiction; vendor must provide attestation."

Sara (Security): that is stricter than our default hosted offering. two paths: 1) provide attestation for Dedicated/Private with BYO-KMS (we support HSM-backed KMS integration) OR 2) suggest a proxying approach where keys never leave customer's HSM and we use a per-request envelope key. both require legal + infra signoff.
Jon (Platform Eng): technically we can stage a private deployment in eu-west-1 and wire up their KMS via our KMS connector. estimated spin-up + validation: ~48 hours if infra priority.
Priya (Sales Lead): customer timeline? CISO wants sign-off by Friday EOD. that's 72 hours. can we compress to that?
Alyssa (AE): they're pushing for Friday. if we can't get attestation, they'll cancel the on-site proof-of-concept.
Mike (Solutions Eng): @Sara — what evidence does Security need to provide an attestation? certs? penetration test? recommended language for the redline?
Sara (Security): we need: (a) confirmation we can connect to their KMS via approved network path (VPC peering or VPN), (b) KMS attestation doc (HSM model + FIPS cert + public attestation PDF), (c) access controls + audit log retention statement. I'll draft a one-page attestation template.
Alyssa (AE): awesome — can you also add the minimal phrasing Legal can accept for the SQ redline? customer legal is picky.
Sara (Security): will do. pinging legal separately.
ops-bot: runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/playbooks/byo-kms-poc|BYO-KMS POC runbook> — includes checklist for dedicated env, network steps, and evidence artifacts.
Jon (Platform Eng): operations note: for shortest path we propose a Private deployment + direct KMS integration. fallback: hosted with envelope keys but customer will likely reject.
Mike (Solutions Eng): I can assemble a tech note for the CISO that walks through network diagrams + short flow. put my name on it and share with Alyssa by EOD.
Priya (Sales Lead): to escalate: we should do an exec-bridge with LumenAxis CISO + our Security lead tomorrow morning. Alyssa, can you coordinate availability? I'll loop in customer execs.
Alyssa (AE): yes — proposing 9:30am PT tomorrow. I'll send a calendar invite after Sara/Law confirm availability.
Sara (Security): I can join. Jon can be on standby for infra Qs.
Jon (Platform Eng): available. I'll prepare the deployment ETA + checklist (48h plan).
Alyssa (AE): action items: Alyssa — schedule exec bridge; Sara — draft attestation + redline language; Jon — deployment ETA & network diagram; Mike — technical note for CISO; Priya — coordinate customer execs.
Priya (Sales Lead): also need to flag potential pricing delta for Dedicated/Private — finance will need to sign off if we allocate reserved capacity. Alyssa, can you add preliminary pricing impact to the invite?
Alyssa (AE): will do.
Mike (Solutions Eng): quick sample of the KMS policy they asked about (scrubbed):
```
resource "kms_key" "customer" {
  provider = "external_hsm"
  policy = <<POLICY
{
  "KeyUsage": "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT",
  "Origin": "EXTERNAL_HSM",
  "Restrictions": {"Residency": "EU"}
}
POLICY
}
```
Jon (Platform Eng): note: network testing will need a temp test principal from the customer to validate handshake – ask them to provision a short-lived service account.
Alyssa (AE): I'll request that in the invite thread.
Sara (Security): final note: if Legal redlines indemnity/KMS clause, escalate to legal counsel. I'm drafting the minimum security acceptance criteria now.
Alyssa (AE): thanks all — I'll update thread after the invite. if anything changes before the bridge, drop updates here. :thumbsup:
